cases.name: bound, remove: false landing: the thief (one device of three) lands an eviction of the owner's device; the owner's two devices objected and the landing leaves them unnamed
bound, remove: false landing, stated falsely: the same landing naming the objections
bound, remove: false landing, early: the thief lands before its own window has run
bound, remove: withheld row: the target used its device in the window (a row that is no objection) and a relay kept it from everyone until after the landing
bound, remove: the owner is away the whole window and signs nothing; the thief lands
bound, remove: objection signed just after, naming the landing: the owner returns and objects honestly
bound, remove: objection signed just after, leaving the landing unnamed: the owner returns and objects with both devices
bound, remove: a second landing naming both: after the thief's landing, the owner's second device lands 'refused', naming the landing and the objections
bound, remove: lost device: the owner holds one of three and evicts a lost device, which signs nothing
bound, remove: silent stolen device: the same eviction; the target is held by a thief who signs a row after the landing and leaves it unnamed
bound, remove: quorum: the owner's two devices evict the stolen one at once; the thief objects, concurrent with the landing
bound, remove: the count with no landing: the owner's two devices approve the eviction of the stolen one and nobody lands
bound, remove: the others refuse with no landing: the thief proposes and the owner's two devices object
bound, remove: one approval short of the count, no landing: nothing has changed
bound, remove: the proposer withdraws its open proposal
bound, remove: a withdrawal beside a majority's approval, neither naming the other
bound, remove: an approval that names the withdrawal
bound, remove: a withdrawal in the lone landing's past: the landing states 'landed' over it
bound, remove: a withdrawal concurrent with the lone landing
bound, remove: a withdrawal that names the lone landing: it came after
bound, remove: another key signs a withdrawal of the proposal
bound, admit: the count with no landing: two of three approve the new key
bound, admit: a proposal alone: the key of an addition is not seated while the window is open
bound, admit: the lone path: nobody answers in 24 h and the proposer lands
bound, admit: false landing, early: the thief lands its own key before its window has run
bound, admit: the others refuse: the thief proposes its own key and the owner's two devices object, no landing
bound, admit: false landing: the thief lands its key at the close, leaving the two objections unnamed
bound, admit: one objection of two others is not a refusal: the thief lands at the close over it
bound, admit: the key being added signs rows in the window: an addition has no target's silence
bound, admit: the proposer withdraws the addition
a room's content change, two of three approve: strictly more than 2/3 needs three
a room's content change, three of three approve
a room's content change, two of three approve and a member lands the floor at the close
a room's content change, the proposer alone and a member lands at the close: the floor is two voices
an opener that proposes nothing is bound to no family
an opener the name alone would bind: the binding reads no name
a removal's opener: community_remove is a counted row, no window
an admission stating community_invite, two of three approve
an admission stating community_invite, three of three approve
an admission stating cosigned_act: a counted row, no window
an admission stating no policy, where the row chooses
a content change stating another policy than the fixed one
a record change: two counts at once is no window
an act the acts table has no row for over a room

families.note: the class every reversible content change inherits unless a row names it

families.note: roster and standing changes: who is a member; a duty seat has its own two rows

families.note: the invitee's own acceptance is still required (3.1.3.2) and is the second of the floor's two voices: a room of one grows by its one member's proposal and the newcomer's yes; no single vote admits by silence; an active member emits the proposal (3.3.4)
families.standing_set: the community's roster

families.note: forward only, cosigned under the room's protocol; the member being removed is not counted and is no voice; never fewer than two voices, so a room of two removes nobody; the row lands when its count is met and needs no concluder (2.7.5); at the hold window's end a node drops the voices it holds, and that is no verdict (3.3.4)
families.standing_set: the community's roster

families.cancel: more than 1/2 of the others (strict majority)
families.note: one person's own keys: a floor of one key is right here; unilateral at one key; two keys stalemate
families.standing_set: the live roster keys of one fedID

families.cancel: more than 1/2 of the others (strict majority)
families.note: as add, and the target silent all window
families.standing_set: the live roster keys of one fedID

families.floor: more than 1/2 of those who voted, at least 2 voices
families.note: a holder of `moderate` acts alone in the window; on the moderators' absence a strict majority of the members who voted, never fewer than two voices; any member proposes and any member lands the fallback
families.standing_set: the live community

families.note: the members' check: a strict majority of those seated at the head the act names, its author apart, lift a duty holder's single-signature act within the window; below that the act stands; a restored item returns consent-gated; the duty holder's act opens the window and its author's objection is no voice; any member but the act's author lands the lift
families.standing_set: the community's roster at the head the act names, less the act's author

families.note: the members recall any duty holder, however seated: more than two thirds of the standing roster cosign one row in the standing window; where that leaves no duty holder the room locks and elects; a counted row under the hold of 3.3.4
families.standing_set: the community's roster, less the holder it recalls

families.floor: 2 voices, or the roster's size if smaller
families.note: a duty seat is conferred by a strict majority of all the duty holders of the room it is conferred in, with the new holder's acceptance; a lone duty holder confers alone; a duty conferral is held as every counted row short of its count is (3.3.4)
families.standing_set: the community's duty holders

families.note: a duty seat is withdrawn by a strict majority of the other duty holders, the holder concerned not counted; one other holder alone withdraws nothing, and the members' recall stays; a counted row under the hold of 3.3.4
families.standing_set: the community's duty holders, less the holder concerned

families.note: one holder fires at once; lapses at the fuse unless a majority confirms; a majority resumes; the fuse is each node's own and has no landing; the confirmation is a cosigned accord:lifecycle:confirmed row naming the halt (4.2.1.1)
families.standing_set: the accord holders

families.note: the operator and the WA name the successor by one cosigned row; the old key's custody rows stay valid to that instant
families.standing_set: the operator holding the record + the Wise Authority

families.note: a one-voice affiliation acts against a member only with an outside countersign; two or more seats decide under their own protocol
families.standing_set: the deciding seat + one key outside it (the designated official, or a review-holder of the overseeing body)

families.enact: instant runoff over ranked choice of three
families.floor: 2 voices, or the roster's size if smaller
families.note: a locked room elects its moderator: ballot = the roster, its shown order deciding nothing, one ballot per person, a tie seats nobody and the count runs again, winner accepts or the next in runoff order; nothing signed opens an election; the winner's acceptance binds the ballot set it was seated on
families.standing_set: the community's roster

families.floor: 2 voices, or the roster's size if smaller
families.note: the members open an election for an ended duty seat; no duty is needed to open
families.standing_set: the room's members, as persons, at the newest heads

families.note: a cosigned row of a group lands when the signatures held meet the rule of the group's declared protocol; a shortfall is held for the hold window, which a group may set longer and never shorter, and then dropped
families.standing_set: the group's roster, counted as its declared protocol states

families.note: a strict majority of the standing accord roster cosign one row: the confirmation and the resumption of a halt, and the standing acts; a roster change runs its own participation window (CC 4.2.6)
families.standing_set: the accord holders

families.floor: more than 1/2 of those who voted, at least 2 voices
families.note: a poll states its own rule in the row that opens it; where it states none, a strict majority of those who voted, never fewer than two voices, one ballot a person; the poll's own close ends it, so the row carries no window; a secret poll's result is the tally member's ballot:tally row (6.1.9)
families.standing_set: the roster the poll's opening row names

families.note: a finding of the designated Wise Authority body is one row cosigned under the body's own declared protocol, as any cosigned act of a group; the denominator is the full seated roster, never the live subset; a counted row under the hold of 3.3.4
families.standing_set: the designated body's full seated roster, counted as its declared protocol states
